citation: Myers, D., Olsen, R., Seftor, N., Young, J., & Tuttle, C. (2004). The Impacts of Regular Upward Bound: Results from the Third Follow-Up Data Collection. Mathematica Policy Research for U.S. Department of Education. ERIC ED518667.
